observations.methodology: Seven fresh processes per version/input/budget, rotating/reversing order, workUnits=1 and 4096. Same uninstrumented timing source linked against pinned pre-scan, retained scan, pooled-only and final adapters/upstream libraries. Full pixels checked against frozen pre-scan references. No fonts. Step timers exclude begin/input copy/take/drop/IPC and clock gaps; process duration includes startup and all operations. Process caches empty; OS page cache and system load uncontrolled. Other stage builds/tests completed before this measurement. Diagnostic sample medians, not P95, end-to-end cancellation, RSS or product acceptance.

latency.scope: Per-version allocation and timing attribution; retained continuation throughput versus the pre-scan reference remains a separate requirement from improved cancellation opportunities. No quality/reference/workload relaxation.

exploratoryBuilds.scope: Initial native adapter has task storage reuse without capture/first-resume coalescing, used only for attribution. Final native adapter binds the same verified upstream archive. ASan and WASM upstream builds already include both changes.
